text:
Matt H: Heads-up — aiming to push release v2.4.1 tonight at 00:30 PST. I want a quick rollback runbook sign-off and ownership for the quiet window.
Sam K: I can own the rollback execution and monitor. Will be on call during the window. :thumbsup:
Priya R: I reviewed the runbook; added a step to scrub KV cache before rollforward. small nit in step 3.
Lee C: Can you paste the exact rollback commands? I want to pre-stage the playbook.
Matt H: Yup — putting them here. Use the backup tag `v2.3.9-stable` and run the orchestrator rollback: ```
./deployctl rollback --service api --to-tag v2.3.9-stable --graceful
# fallback: ./deployctl promote --pool hotfix
```
Alice M: Smoke checks list I recommend: 1) /health 2) sample-gen @ 1000qps 3) DB read/write on replica 4) latency P95 under 300ms.
Ben S: QA Bot will run the end-to-end suite once canary hits 10%. @QA Bot please trigger at 10% and post results.
QA Bot: queued: e2e/regression against canary at 10%. will post pass/fail.
Sam K: Rollback criteria I'm comfortable with: - >=5% error rate sustained for 3m OR - p95 latency > 700ms for 5m OR - critical user-facing failures (auth/checkout). If any of these hit, we abort and rollback.
Priya R: Added an ops check: if prefix-KV cache miss spikes > 40% during canary, consider rollback.
Lee C: How long is the quiet window?
Matt H: 40 minutes total: 10m canary ramp (0->10%), 20m steady at 10%, 10m decision buffer.
OnCall Ops: I'll be watching infra metrics and will send a GO/NO-GO by +30m if nothing bad. Ping me with `/urgent` to escalate.
Sam K: Preflight checklist done: DB replica lag < 50ms, infra capacity 120% of expected qps, alert hooks in place.
Alice M: I'll run the smoke scripts right after canary reaches 10%. script snippet: ```bash
curl -sS https://api.prod/health || exit 1
python tools/smoke_test.py --samples 50
```
Matt H: Final ask: everyone ACK the runbook and role. If no objections in 30m, we'll proceed. :white_check_mark:
Ben S: ACK — QA will post results and standby.
Priya R: ACK.
Lee C: ACK and I have rollback script ready in `ops/rollbacks/v2.4.1.sh`.
Sam K: ACK, I'll execute if we hit criteria.
OnCall Ops: ACK, monitoring ready.
Matt H: Great — saving this thread as the deploy anchor. I'll update with the exact kickoff timestamp 15m before start. Thanks all.
